title: Taking an initial segment
statement: Let $\mu : \mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, let $l$ be a finite list of integers, and let $k\in\mathbb{N}$. If $\mu(a+i)=l_i$ for every index $i<|l|$, then $\mu(a+i)=(l\mathbin{\mathrm{take}}k)_i$ for every index in the list formed by taking the first $k$ entries of $l$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ agrees with $l$ at every index in the segment starting at $a$
